# Agents Kit 0.2.0

> React components for conversations, generated results, and agent interactions. Copy source into your application through the shadcn-compatible registry.

Components receive data through props and return user intent through callbacks. Your application owns model calls, streaming, tool execution, permissions, and persistence. This library does not supply an agent backend.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/docs/introduction)
- [Installation and required styles](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/docs/installation)
- [Component catalog](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/components)
- [Generative playground](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/generative)
- [MCP setup](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/docs/mcp): use the standard shadcn MCP server with the @agents-kit registry namespace.
- [Registry index](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/registry.json)
- [Full API reference](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/llms-full.txt)
- [v0.1 archive](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/v0.1)
- [Migration guide](https://github.com/agents-ui/agents-kit/blob/main/docs/migrating-to-v0.2.md)
- [Source and README](https://github.com/agents-ui/agents-kit)
- [Credits and licenses](https://github.com/agents-ui/agents-kit/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

- [chat-container](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/chat-container.json): A component for creating chat interfaces with intelligent auto-scrolling behavior, designed to provide a smooth and responsive user experience
- [code-block](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/code-block.json): A component for displaying code snippets with syntax highlighting and customizable styling
- [file-upload](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/file-upload.json): A component for creating drag-and-drop file upload interfaces with support for single or multiple files, custom triggers, and visual feedback during file dragging operations.
- [jsx-preview](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/jsx-preview.json): A component for rendering JSX strings as React components, with support for streaming content and automatic tag completion.
- [loader](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/loader.json): A component for displaying a loading indicator with multiple variants and customizable styling
- [markdown](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/markdown.json): A component for rendering Markdown content with support for code blocks, GFM, and custom styling
- [message](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/message.json): A component for displaying chat messages with support for avatars, markdown content, and interactive actions
- [prompt-input](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/prompt-input.json): An input field designed for chat interfaces, allowing users to enter and submit text prompts to an AI model
- [prompt-suggestion](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/prompt-suggestion.json): A component for implementing interactive prompt suggestions in AI interfaces. The PromptSuggestion component offers two distinct modes: Normal Mode and Highlight Mode.
- [reasoning](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/reasoning.json): A collapsible component for showing AI reasoning, explanations, or logic. You can control it manually or let it auto-close when the stream ends. Markdown is supported.
- [response-stream](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/response-stream.json): A component to simulate streaming text on the client side, perfect for fake responses, or any controlled progressive text display.
- [scroll-button](https://agents-ui.github.io/agents-kit/c/scroll-button.json): A floating button component that appears when users scroll up in a container, allowing them to quickly return to the bottom of the content
